title: Fuel-optimal Boost-Back Guidance via Successive Convexification with a Terminal Constraint for ReusableLaunch Vehicles
summary: This paper proposes a fuel-optimal boost-back guidance algorithm for reusable launch vehicles using successive convexification (SCvx). The guidance problem is formulated as a free-final-time optimal control problem with a terminal instantaneous impact point (IIP) constraint. This constraint depends only on the burnout position and velocity and enforces that the predicted ballistic impact point coincides with the target under a spherical-Earth, central-gravity model.
